data.title: Bigger Blocks Are Coming to Ethereum
data.summary_raw: Sepolia's gas limit hit Glamsterdam's 200M target just 11 hours after the fork. Here's how Ethereum's next upgrade makes room for much bigger blocks.

data.title: Quantus Takes Aim at Bitcoin’s Quantum Problem
data.summary_raw: QTC is now tradable through NEAR Intents, giving the quantum-resistant L1 its first real liquidity test against Bitcoin and Zcash.

data.title: Bitwise Is Pitching NEAR to Wall Street as an AI Bet
data.summary_raw: Bitwise's NRR, the first U.S. spot NEAR ETF, drew $35.5M on day one. Hunter Horsley and Sal Ternullo explain the demand and NEAR's AI-first pitch.
